title: Union (Tribalist)
problem: For Health, each creature receives X% of the current Max Health of every same-race ally whose highest stat is Health, one creature after another. Allies handled earlier have already received their share, so later creatures get more (it compounds). The text describes a fixed % of each creature's highest stat. The other four stats are worked out live in the stat getters and don't have this problem.
notes: Community claim: Health gains grow along the party, each creature getting ~10% more than the previous one. Evidence: bc_StartupStatGain L781-789: for each creature c on your side: allies = bc_GetAlliesOf(c, false, false) (@0x141730b7d); if same race and Health is the ally's highest stat: amt = round(ally.hpmax x 0.01 x rank) (hpmax read @0x1417311bf, perk 162 @0x1417312ea); c.hpmax += amt; c.hp += amt (@0x1417314ae / 0x14173156c). Fix sketch: H: take every creature's Max Health before the loop starts Triage 2026-10-26: Health shares compound along the party. Hook: read every creature's Max Health before the loop. Batch R: not built. Needs every creature's Max Health snapshotted before the L781-789 loop (array iteration from C, helper not yet mapped). Round-2 hook (A2): bc_StartupStatGain is wrapped with a snapshot of your creatures' Max Health; the Health share's ally.hpmax read (L787) uses the snapshot. In-game test: Union with 3+ same-race creatures whose highest stat is Health: the Health each one gains is the same % of each ally's starting Max Health, not rising along the party.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures grant a % of their highest stat to your other creatures of the same race.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, for Health, shares compounded along the party, so later creatures received more.
release_notes.fix: Now each share is taken from every creature's Maximum Health at the start of battle.
